text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text: And here it is! Derby Week!

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
This week's broadcast will feature live 
interviews with the runners! Now, over to 
Ines Fujin at the live feed—take it away!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right here! It's Ines Fujin and her 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer-san. You are looking super 
stiff and nervous~.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Well, my trainee is running in the Derby! 
And she has great records, talented enough 
to have victory well within her sights!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, do you ever feel the 
burden is too heavy?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. This person promised to make me 
win as the number-one favorite!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I can be really selfish, you know. Being 
able to run in the Derby like this is all 
thanks to Trainer and my family."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (—That's why I believe in you.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(My family wasn't that well-off. Honestly, 
entering the Academy was a situation where 
I was causing trouble for them...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, Mom and Dad told me not to worry 
about it. And my little sisters cheered me 
on, telling me to do my best.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...And yet, there's a part of me that 
just can't fully indulge in that 
kindness.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I really should be focusing on my 
training. Yet here I am, selfishly wanting 
to keep my part-time job just to support 
my little sisters' dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Because this person... ...accepted 
someone like me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—She's an incredible person, truly. So 
don't worry, everyone, and just watch over 
her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because we're strong. Even if we're 
favored, we're two racers who can win as 
the favorites.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Derby as the first favorite is 
my dream right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Heheh~ I ended up talking pretty big 
in that interview~"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I simply can't lose this now. Hehehe, 
Trainer, are you prepared?"
choice_data_list: I've always believed you could win.
I've always believed you can win.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I know that already.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In the races ahead... I'm gonna pour 
everything I have into them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —In order to win.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOO!! Ineees!! Ryaaann!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What sheer fanaticism! We're even hearing 
reports that today's Derby attendance may 
break all historical records!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This is our first time running in a race 
together since the Satsuki Sho, isn't it, 
Ines?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it was just a month ago.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, Ryan-chan has grown into someone 
with an even more dependable back. Every 
time I see her, she looks remarkably 
different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...You think so? Haha, then I'm truly 
honored.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I bet you didn't even realize. It was you 
pulling me forward that brought me all the 
way here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Because through you, I saw my own dream."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...? A dream...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't give up the Derby! Even 
if you run away at the front, I'll chase 
you down in the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Fufu. Hey, Ryan-chan—

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Big siiis! Do your beeest--!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That won't do. I won't let you. I'm not 
giving up 1st place either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Understood, then it's a match.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, a match. Because I'm also—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Because I came here to make my dreams 
come true.
